extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians and advanced graduate students in arithmetic geometry, anabelian geometry, and readers of Mochizuki's IUT papers
extracted.subtask_description: An expository overview of inter-universal Teichmüller theory (IUT) describing the principal structures (Θ-links, log-links, Frobenioids, Hodge theaters), their compatibility properties, and the key technical devices (Kummer-detachment, multiradiality, cyclotomic rigidity) used to prove the main multiradial/multiradiality results. Aimed at conveying which constructions/compatibilities must hold in IUT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use F_l^±-symmetry for conjugate synchronization
rubrics_metrics.description: The F(cid:3)±_l-symmetry is geometric in nature and allows one to permute various copies of “Gv” associated to distinct labels ∈ F_l without inducing conjugacy indeterminacies; this phenomenon is referred to as conjugate synchronization and is central in the Kummer theory surrounding the Hodge-Arakelov-theoretic evaluation of the theta function at l-torsion points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the F_l^±-symmetry (rather than F_l^(2)-symmetry) in situations requiring precise control so that permutations of copies of G_v avoid conjugacy indeterminacies; see discussion of conjugate synchronization and references [IUTchI], [IUTchII].

rubrics_metrics.name: Use F_l^(2)-symmetry for descent to Fmod
rubrics_metrics.description: The F_l^(2)-symmetry is more suited to situations in which one must descend from K to Fmod; such situations necessarily induce global Galois permutations of the various copies of “Gv” associated to distinct labels ∈ F_l that are only well-defined up to conjugacy indeterminacies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer F_l^(2)-symmetry when the goal is to reconstruct or descend number fields (Fmod) from ΠCK, but be aware that it produces global permutations defined only up to conjugacy — hence it is ill-suited when conjugate synchronization is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decompose Fl into additive and multiplicative arithmetic dimensions
rubrics_metrics.description: A Θ±ellNF-Hodge theater may be regarded as a decomposition of the ring F_l into its two underlying arithmetic dimensions: addition (associated to the F_l^±-symmetry) and multiplication (associated to the F_l^(2)-symmetry).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat constructions in a Θ±ellNF-Hodge theater by distinguishing the additive (‘cuspidal’) and multiplicative (‘toral/nodal’) aspects; use the analogy with additive/multiplicative symmetries of the upper half-plane and their associated coordinates (q-parameter vs unit-disc coordinate) to guide which symmetry and associated tools to deploy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Log-link compatibility with pv-adic logarithm and indeterminate isomorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Each log-link relates domain and codomain ring structures at v∈Vnon via the pv-adic logarithm log_v : F_v^× → F_v, and the log-link is compatible with “some” isomorphism Π_v ∼→ Π_v between the arithmetic fundamental groups on either side only up to indeterminate isomorphism of abstract topological groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When working with log-links, regard the arithmetic fundamental groups only up to indeterminate isomorphism and account for the gap between ring/scheme-theoretic basepoints; the vertical coricity property (invariance up to isomorphism) is the relevant notion of invariance for these groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertical coricity of arithmetic fundamental groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Corresponding arithmetic fundamental groups of the Θ±ellNF-Hodge theaters in the domain and codomain of the log-link are related by indeterminate isomorphisms of abstract topological groups; this invariance (up to indeterminate isomorphism) is referred to as vertical coricity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat Π_v, Π_XK, Π_CK as invariants of vertical lines of the log-theta-lattice only up to abstract topological isomorphism; use absolute anabelian geometry to reconstruct the arithmetic holomorphic (ring) structure from these groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Θ-link defined via non-ring-homomorphism involving O×μ and theta values (subject to (Z^)×-indeterminacies)
rubrics_metrics.description: At v∈Vbad the Θ-link relates the domain and codomain via a non-ring-homomorphism involving (G_v (cid:2) O×μ_{F_v}) and an assignment of certain theta-values {q_j^2}_{j=1,...,l/2}; the module O×μ is regarded as an abstract topological module equipped with an integral structure and is subject to Z^×-indeterminacies (raising to λ-th power).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When forming Θ-links, model O×μ as an abstract topological module with integral structure and work modulo the (Z^)×-indeterminacy; interpret the theta-value assignment as an isomorphism of abstract monoids (both ∼= N). Ensure compatibility with some unspecified isomorphism G_v ∼→ G_v of Galois groups up to indeterminacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define 'wall' by working with abstract topological monoids (Frobenius-like structures)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ‘wall’ constituted by the assignment that gives rise to the Θ-link (and analogously the log-link) can only be defined by working with abstract topological monoids, i.e., Frobenius-like structures, rather than with the full reconstruction data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To glue Θ±ellNF-Hodge theaters along prime-strips, strip the abstract monoids of any information about how they were reconstructed from arithmetic fundamental groups; this yields isomorphic objects enabling the gluing. Conversely, ´etale-like structures penetrate these walls and are needed to reconstruct ring data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish étale-like vs Frobenius-like structures
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a fundamental dichotomy: the ´etale-like portion consists of arithmetic fundamental groups (G_k, G_F, G_v, Π_v, Π_XK, Π_CK) and is vertically coric; the Frobenius-like portion consists of abstract monoids (e.g., O ∪ {0}) and, when regarded up to indeterminate isomorphism together with the reconstruction algorithm, may be seen as étale-like as well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the viewpoint appropriate to the task: use Frobenius-like (abstract monoid) perspective to define Θ-links/log-links and to perform gluing; use étale-like viewpoint and anabelian reconstruction to penetrate walls and recover ring/scheme-theoretic structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Θ-link must be compatible with the product formula (definition for Vgood)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Θ-link is defined for both nonarchimedean and archimedean v∈Vgood so as to be compatible with the definition at v∈Vbad, relative to the product formula of elementary number theory; this compatibility allows one to define the Θ-link for certain global realiﬁed Frobenioids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure local definitions of Θ-links at bad places are extended to good places in a way compatible with the global product formula to obtain global Frobenioid-level Θ-links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form associated ´etale-picture by permuting vertically coric copies
rubrics_metrics.description: If one regards vertically coric copies of Π_v arising from distinct vertical lines as related by some indeterminate isomorphism, then one obtains a diagram whose spokes (arising from vertical lines) are invariant under arbitrary permutations; this diagram of ´etale-like structures is the associated ´etale-picture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When synthesizing global structure from vertical lines, work up to indeterminate isomorphism and exploit permutation-invariance to pass from log-theta-lattice spokes to the symmetric ´etale-picture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform Kummer-detachment (transition from Frobenius-like to étale-like via Kummer theory)
rubrics_metrics.description: The transition from Frobenius-like structures (cartesian/log-theta coordinates) to ´etale-like structures (the ´etale-picture) is effected by Kummer-detachment, i.e., by applying versions of Kummer theory to the Frobenius-like components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply Kummer theory systematically to the three Frobenius-like components in the domain of the Θ-link to detach multiplicative monoid data and pass to reconstructed étale-data; Kummer-detachment plays the role analogous to passing from cartesian to polar coordinates in certain computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kummer theory must establish cyclotomic rigidity and decoupling for components (a),(b),(c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Kummer theory centers on the three Frobenius-like components in the domain of the Θ-link: (a) units modulo torsion O×μ_{F_v} at v∈Vbad; (b) the theta values {q_j^2}; (c) the corresponding global realiﬁed Frobenioids. One must establish appropriate cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms between cyclotomes arising from multiplicative monoids and those from Galois/arithmetic fundamental groups, and decouple (b),(c) from (a) to render (b),(c) immune to (Z^)×-indeterminacies acting on (a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use conjugate synchronization from F_l^±-symmetry and local class field theory to establish Kummer-theory rigidity for (a); overcome the Z^× obstruction by constructing non-classical cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms for (b) and (c) (see [EtTh], [IUTchII], [IUTchIII]).

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify non-existence of unexpected intersections of profinite conjugates
rubrics_metrics.description: When performing Hodge-Arakelov theoretic evaluation of theta functions at l-torsion points (with labels from Θ±ell-Hodge theater), it is necessary to verify that profinite conjugates (from profinite geometric fundamental groups) of the various tempered arithmetic fundamental groups at v∈Vbad do not intersect one another in an 'unexpected fashion'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain non-existence of unexpected intersections by applying the technical result (e.g., [IUTchI], Theorem B and the theory of [Semi]); this verification is essential for the Kummer theory arguments and multiradial rigidity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpret rigidity via multiradiality (parallel transport between spokes)
rubrics_metrics.description: The rigidity properties of the ´etale theta function and the related Kummer-theory can be interpreted in terms of multiradiality — a rigidity with respect to 'parallel transport' between spokes of the ´etale-picture — which is reminiscent of Frobenius-crystal structures and of integration/Fourier-analytic analogies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the multiradial viewpoint to phrase and prove rigidity statements (Theorem 4.1) and to explicate how the theta values become highly distinguished; this perspective underlies the proof strategies and analogies with Gaussian integral/Fourier transform computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theta values are highly distinguished; do not replace by arbitrary q^N
rubrics_metrics.description: The intricate technical apparatus of IUT collapses if one attempts to work with arbitrary powers q^N of q instead of the specified theta values {q_j^2}; the distinguished nature of these theta values is crucial for the theory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain the canonical theta-values arising from the Θ±ell-Hodge theater bookkeeping apparatus and do not substitute them by arbitrary powers; rigidity and cyclotomic-decoupling arguments depend critically on these choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use absolute anabelian geometry to recover ring/scheme-theoretic structures (inter-universality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Because the assignments comprising log- and Θ-links are not ring homomorphisms, one must work with Galois groups as abstract topological groups (without embeddings into Aut_field(k)) and apply absolute anabelian geometry to describe ring/scheme-theoretic structures on the opposite side of the wall; this is the 'inter-universal' aspect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ absolute anabelian reconstruction (e.g., [AbsTopIII], [FrdI], [FrdII]) to recover arithmetic holomorphic structures from abstract fundamental groups and manage changes of universe (labeling apparatus) when passing between domain and codomain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with distinct labeling apparatuses (universes) due to log-theta-lattice non-commutativity
rubrics_metrics.description: The log-theta-lattice is highly non-commutative and obligates one to work with distinct labeling apparatuses (distinct 'universes' or choices of basepoints/coordinates) in the domain and codomain of vertical arrows; identification of copies (e.g., to make Π_v the identity) would require ring-structure identifications incompatible with the Θ-link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When comparing domain and codomain, do not force identifications of base field copies that would reintroduce ring-homomorphism structure; instead, manage 'changes of universe' analogously to changes of coordinates in the classical theta-function/Jacobi identity context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept Theorem 4.1 multiradial description of Θ-link components
rubrics_metrics.description: The three Frobenius-like components (a),(b),(c) that appear in the domain of the Θ-link admit a multiradial description in terms of the a priori 'alien' arithmetic holomorphic structure in the codomain of the Θ-link; the figure/tabulation summarizes related symmetries, approaches to compatibility, and (in)compatibilities with the log-link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Theorem 4.1 as a guideline for how components (a) units modulo torsion, (b) theta values, and (c) global realiﬁed Frobenioids behave (e.g., multiradial vs uniradial, approaches like cyclotomic rigidity/local class field theory, compatibility statements) when establishing the main IUT results; consult the accompanying table/figure for precise compatibilities.
